sections.title: Using this site
paragraphs: This website is published by TEMS Academy of Olympiad Math & Science, House 06, Road 1/1, Shekertek Adabor, Mohammadpur-1207, Dhaka, Bangladesh. By using the site you agree to these terms.
The site is provided for information. You may read, print and share pages for personal, non-commercial use.

sections.title: Information and results
paragraphs: We publish results, fees and batch details only when the academy has supplied or confirmed them. Where a detail is not confirmed, the site says so rather than filling the gap with a guess.
Competition results depend on the official organiser. TEMS does not guarantee selection for a national team, a medal or a particular competition outcome.

sections.title: Applications and placement
paragraphs: An application is a request for a diagnostic and a placement conversation. It is not an offer of a place and does not create a contract.
Placement is based on the diagnostic and the academy’s judgement of the appropriate division and tier. The batch, session and fee are confirmed in writing before the first class.

sections.title: Fees
paragraphs: The published monthly fee is Tk 2,500 for Mathematics and Tk 2,700 for Science. The fee does not change when a student is promoted to a higher tier.
The payment method and billing date are confirmed at placement. Scholarships and cash prizes are awarded separately at the Chairman’s discretion and are not a standard discount.

sections.title: Attendance, changes and refunds
paragraphs: Batch changes, attendance rules and any refund arrangement are confirmed in the academy’s enrolment terms at placement. This website does not publish a refund policy.
If a batch is on hold or an intake changes, the academy will offer the running alternative or the next available intake.

sections.title: Content and photographs
paragraphs: The text, design and original problems on this site belong to TEMS Academy. Photographs are used with the academy’s permission. Do not republish them without written consent.
You may quote a short passage with attribution and a link to this site.

sections.title: External links
paragraphs: Links to olympiad organisers and other external sites are provided for reference. We do not control those sites and are not responsible for their content or availability.

sections.title: Contact
paragraphs: Questions about these terms: temsonline3.14@gmail.com or WhatsApp +880 1771-396000.

sections.title: Who we are
paragraphs: TEMS Academy of Olympiad Math & Science is based at House 06, Road 1/1, Shekertek Adabor, Mohammadpur-1207, Dhaka, Bangladesh.
For privacy questions or requests, write to temsonline3.14@gmail.com.

sections.title: What we collect
paragraphs: When you send an application or enquiry, we collect the student’s name, guardian email address, WhatsApp number, class, subject track, past contest experience if you choose to provide it, any message you write, and your consent confirmation.

The hosting provider processes technical request data, including an IP address, to deliver the site and limit abusive form submissions. We do not run advertising cookies, behavioural analytics or cross-site tracking.

sections.title: Why we collect it
paragraphs: We use application details to reply, arrange a diagnostic, discuss placement, and manage admission. We rely on your consent and the need to respond to your request.
We do not sell personal data or use it for third-party advertising.

sections.title: Who processes it
paragraphs: The site is hosted on Cloudflare. Application emails are delivered through an email service provider (Resend) to the academy’s inbox. These providers process data on our behalf to deliver the service.
Only academy staff who need the information for admissions or teaching will see it.

sections.title: Children’s information
paragraphs: Applications must be submitted by a parent or guardian. We ask for guardian consent and do not intentionally collect personal information directly from a child through this site.

sections.title: How long we keep it
paragraphs: We keep application and admissions information only as long as needed to respond, arrange placement and maintain academy records. If you want an application removed, email us and we will delete it unless we are required to keep a record.

sections.title: Security
paragraphs: The site uses HTTPS, server-side validation and rate limiting. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, but we take reasonable steps to protect the information you send.

sections.title: Your choices
paragraphs: You can ask us for a copy of the information you sent, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it. Email temsonline3.14@gmail.com and describe the request.
You can also choose to contact the academy on WhatsApp or by email instead of using the form.

sections.title: Changes
paragraphs: If this policy changes, the updated date at the top of the page will change. Material changes affecting applications will be described on this page.
